concerns.text: The plan states 'simulate a synthetic dataset... OR aggregate data...' but does not explicitly address how the choice between these two approaches will be made, or what criteria will govern that decision. This is missing from the plan.

The plan mentions preprocessing to map variables, but doesn't detail *how* ambiguous data (if encountered) will be handled beyond logging an error. The spec requires a defined strategy; this is missing.

The plan states the model will 'adapt to the data structure', but doesn't specify *how* it detects between/within subjects designs, or what random effects terms are used in each case. The spec requires this detail.
The plan mentions VIF calculation, but does not state a threshold for flagging multicollinearity (the spec states >5.0). This is missing from the plan.

The plan acknowledges sensitivity analysis, but doesn't detail *how* the outlier exclusion thresholds will be applied or what metric will be used to assess the impact on results (the spec specifies 'absolute deviation from cell mean').
The plan states Bonferroni correction will be applied, but doesn't specify *which* comparisons will be made or how the adjusted p-values will be reported (the spec requires pairwise comparisons).

The plan mentions generating a forest plot, but does not detail what data will be included in the plot beyond 'condition means' – specifically, whether confidence intervals will be displayed (the spec requires this).
The plan doesn’t describe *how* the p-value for the interaction term will be measured against the null hypothesis. The success criteria require a defined measurement approach.

The plan does not detail how the stability of the interaction effect will be measured across different outlier thresholds, or what constitutes 'remaining < 0.05'. The success criteria require a clear definition.
The plan doesn't specify *how* the width of the confidence interval will be measured or reported, only that it will be included. The success criteria need more detail.
The plan does not describe how the validity of the risk-taking measure will be assessed against either the source dataset documentation or simulation parameters, as required by the success criteria.
